description: Dock navigation bar for navigating between primary screens.

properties.name: activeItemIndex
properties.description: The currently active dock item index.

properties.name: customClass
properties.description: Custom CSS class to apply to the inner nav element.

properties.name: position
properties.description: The edge the dock is anchored to. Controls layout and active indicator orientation.

properties.name: showLabels
properties.description: If true, text labels are shown below icons.

properties.name: size
properties.description: The size of the dock items.

events.name: itemSelect
events.description: Emitted when a dock item is selected.
